provider: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies (GISS)
data_kind_note: Gridded analysis of station (NOAA GHCN v4, homogenized) and ship/buoy (NOAA ERSST v5) observations, with spatial interpolation (smoothing radius 1200 km or 250 km); it is not a single-point measurement. The 250 km land-only product uses stations only.
citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies. Dataset accessed 2026-11-14 at https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/.

Lenssen, N., G.A. Schmidt, M. Hendrickson, P. Jacobs, M. Menne, and R. Ruedy, 2024: A GISTEMPv4 observational uncertainty ensemble. J. Geophys. Res. Atmos., 129, no. 17, e2023JD040179, doi:10.1029/2023JD040179.
doi_note: DOI of the publication the GISTEMP page asks to cite; the dataset itself has no DOI on that page.

variables.name_en: Surface temperature anomaly, land and ocean (GISTEMP v4, 1200 km smoothing)

aggregations.point: 2°x2° grid cell containing the location (not a station measurement)

variables.name_en: Surface air temperature anomaly, land stations only (GISTEMP v4, 250 km smoothing)

aggregations.point: 2°x2° grid cell containing the location; cells with no station within 250 km are missing

locations: every kind=point location in data/seed/locations.json and data/seed/locations.world.json (aggregation point); global (aggregation area_mean)

new_locations.note_zh: GISTEMP 官方的北半球平均（NH.Ts+dSST.csv）；bbox 只是標示範圍，值不是由 bbox 重算。
GISTEMP 官方的南半球平均（SH.Ts+dSST.csv）；bbox 只是標示範圍，值不是由 bbox 重算。
